reviews.text: This cannabis shop is very chill and has a very nice lounge to smoke and complete with equipment. Really recommend this shop. All nice staff can give good recommendations of weed. Especially they do have delivery too. Great !!

This is by far the best weed shop/smoking lounge in Thailand.  There is always a great selection of flower and it is true top shelf. Currently my favorite strains are the wappa and rainbow cherry for the sativas, sherb cake for their indicas and Lebanese cream for their hash but they always get new stuff.   They always have around 15-20 strains of flower ranging in price and potency and covering a good variety of terpene profiles and around 6 varieties of hash that are all extremely strong.  The homemade edibles are delicious and extremely strong as well.  They use a full spectrum oil that hits way harder then what I was used to from other edibles I've had other places.  The best part of is the hospitality of the shop.  The girls that work there treat you great and you get complimentary bong service anytime you come back with their weed.  Prices are great for the quality and you get discounts for buying more.

I gave them 5 stars when I first stepped foot in this shop. After one hour I gave them 6 stars because the ladies kept refilling my Lay’s munchies. We came back the next day and the experience got even better it’s now at 7 stars.
